'''Mack''' was an alias used by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Cularin Militia]] when he decided to speak out against the [[Expansion Manifesto]], along with his comrades [[Pac]] and [[Grunt]]. The three [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were interviewed by [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Yara Grugara]] for ''[[Eye on Cularin]]'', however Grugara mocked their opinions. It was revealed that Mack had read the Manifesto only once, and only certain sections.
